reuse.why: Keeps the rule in the existing shared getScheduledAmount, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance, and the API field calls the same helper.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the old rounding-mode variant is removed rather than kept alongside.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API model only maps the field through it.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but includes an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts and a release note that still describes the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule.

maintainability.why: One definition of the expected amount, but the new op parameter is optional, so callers that omit it (the desktop-client list, balance and edit views) silently get no approximate-amount handling.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts gains an optional op parameter and an isapprox branch (the rangeRounding parameter is removed); desktop-client callers call it without op
